schema_notes: status = implementation state; catalog_status = whether the entry is part of the curriculum (the Tech Scout may only create 'proposed' entries in the app database, never in this file). phase/roadmap_step refer to docs/plan/ROADMAP.md; legacy_milestone keeps the pre-2.0 M0-M9 label. primary_source is null where no single canonical source has been recorded yet.
completion_policy: Every entry remains in scope. Production eligibility is separate. Adaptations do not satisfy faithful research reproduction entries.

techniques.name: Fixed characters
techniques.mechanism: Split at a configured character budget.
